description: §14.8.10 (S456) — a `<db src="./live.db" tables="assets">` whose live SQLite file (the `live.db.sql` fixture) also holds `invoices (…, tenant_id)`. The compile opens the file and now scans EVERY relation: `invoices` carries `tenant_id` but no `<schema>` / `<db tables=>` declares it, so it is refused. Compiled clean on 2dd6d35d9.
rationale: §14.8.10 (ruling user-voice-scrml.md S456 "b, startup check lands with it"): a SQLite database file the compiler opens at compile time is scanned, and any relation with a `tenant_id` column outside the compilation's tenant set is E-TENANT-UNDECLARED.
